construction: mechanically generated from 6 source abstracts by applying one named perturbation per case; class balance is set by how many perturbations are implemented, not by real-world error frequency
not_sensitivity_specificity: these terms imply a representative sample from a defined population of claims; this is a generated regression benchmark for comparing versions
known_blind_spot: perturbations are generated by the same rules the verifier inspects, so an unimagined error class is unmeasured — the same limit as hand-written cases, at larger scale

held_out.note: written after the verifier and outside the perturbation grammar; 1/6 on first run, which is the number that matters more than the generated 29/29
held_out.known_false_refusal: derived_percentage: 1-0.79=21% is arithmetically correct and is refused, because the numeric check requires a claimed value to appear in the source — the same check that catches magnitude alteration. A false refusal in the safe direction, documented rather than traded away
